body:
Ibrahim A.: Just opened my company MacBook and the setup assistant loops at 'Contact IT'. MDM shows 'Profile conflict' and FileVault never turned on. Intro meeting in 30m, help?

IT Support: Hi Ibrahim 1 Welcome! Can you run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste results? Also confirm macOS build.

Ibrahim A.: Serial: W804G0XXXXX. macOS 14.4. `profiles` says: No enrolled profiles. MDM pane: 'Profile conflict'.

Maya (Onboarding): We had a batch of refurb units that sometimes retain older DEP claims. IT, can you check that serial?

IT Support: Looking... device shows as "claimed by returns" in DEP. I'll unassign and re-provision to new-hires pool now. Do not enable FileVault manually until we confirm enrollment.

Ibrahim A.: Okay. If I need to join the call, can you create a temp admin?

IT Support: Yes — creating one now. Run this single-line command in Terminal to add a 24h temp admin:
```
sudo sysadminctl -addUser temp_ibrahim -fullName "Temp Ibrahim" -password "R3dwoodTmp!" -admin
```
Log in as temp_ibrahim to continue setup; we'll remove it later.

Ibrahim A.: Done, logged in and past the stuck screen.

IT Support: DEP reassign finished. Reboot and sign in with your SSO. After sign-in check System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault.

Ibrahim A.: Rebooted, signed in with SSO, got FileVault prompt: 'Recovery key will be saved to your organization's management system'. Enabling now.

DevTools: Once enrolled, we'll add you to the dev group and push homebrew and Docker scripts. Ping when ready.

Maya (Onboarding): We'll remove temp_ibrahim later today. Ibrahim, welcome to Redwood Inference! If you hit kernel extension prompts, screenshot and paste here.

Ibrahim A.: All good, thanks everyone! :party_parrot:

onboarding-bot: Device W804G0XXXXX assigned to new-hires; temp account scheduled for deletion in 24h. Welcome aboard!"
